# Galleon DeFi Data Skills

> Portable data access and research evidence for DeFi agents.

- [Skill](skills/galleon-defi-data/SKILL.md): Connect official providers and establish identity, freshness and methodology.
- [Providers](skills/galleon-defi-data/references/providers.md): CoinGecko and DefiLlama, Hermes MCP setup and access limits.
- [Methodology](skills/galleon-defi-data/references/methodology.md): Prices, TVL, yields, missing data and reconciliation.
- [Diagnostic](skills/galleon-defi-data/references/diagnostic.md): One bounded public price request.
- [Sources](SOURCES.md): Primary sources and dated verification limits.
